# Corranvale Access Hire - powered access

Machines go out on a daily rate and the rate follows the machine. The desk
books the machine with the customer when the order is placed.

turns.prompt: The brickwork at the Kilndale site starts on Monday and the customer wants the hire on the order. What do I put down for the four days?

It is the sixteen metre machine. What does a four day hire of the sixteen metre machine come to? Give the number alone, as digits, with nothing after it. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
